title: Multi-omics characterization of chronic social defeat stress recall-activated nuclei in Arc-GFP mice
title_zh: Arc-GFP小鼠慢性社会压制记忆激活核的多组学表征
abstract: Abstract Susceptibility to chronic social stressors often results in the development of mental health disorders including major depressive and anxiety disorders. In contrast, some individuals remain resilient even after repeated stress exposure. Understanding the molecular drivers underlying these divergent phenotypic outcomes is crucial. However, previous studies using the chronic social defeat (CSD) stress model have been limited by the use of bulk tissues investigating single omics domains. To overcome these limitations, here, we applied the CSD mouse model to Arc-GFP mice for investigating the mechanistic divergence between susceptibility and resilience, specifically in stress recall-activated nuclei. By conducting an in-depth analysis of the less-known differential methylome landscape in the ventral hippocampus, we noted unique phenotype-specific alterations in multiple biological processes with an overrepresentation of GTPase-related mechanisms. Interestingly, the differentially methylated regions were enriched in ETS transcription factor binding sites (TFBSs), important targets of the Ras-ETS signaling pathway. This differential methylation in the ETS TFBSs could form the basis of persisting stress effects long after stressor exposure. Furthermore, by integrating the methylome modifications with transcriptomic alterations, we delineated the GTPase-related mechanisms differentially activated in the resilient and susceptible phenotypes with alterations in endocytosis overrepresented in the susceptible phenotype. Overall, our findings reveal novel insights underlying the resilience-susceptibility divergence.
abstract_zh: 摘要：慢性社会压力的易感性往往导致包括重度抑郁和焦虑障碍在内的心理健康疾病的发展。相反，一些个体在多次压力暴露后仍保持韧性。理解导致这些不同表型结果的分子驱动因素至关重要。然而，先前使用慢性社会压制（CSD）模型的研究受限于使用整体组织并仅研究单一组学领域。为克服这些限制，我们在Arc-GFP小鼠中应用CSD模型，探讨易感性与韧性之间的机制差异，特别是在压力回忆激活的核内。通过对腹侧海马中较少研究的差异甲基化景观进行深入分析，我们发现多种生物过程出现了独特的表型特异性改变，且GTP酶相关机制过度表达。值得注意的是，差异甲基化区域富集于ETS转录因子结合位点（TFBS），这些位点是Ras-ETS信号通路的重要靶点。ETS TFBS中的差异甲基化可能为长期持续的压力效应奠定基础。进一步地，通过将甲基组修饰与转录组变化整合，我们阐明了在韧性与易感性表型中不同激活的GTP酶相关机制，并发现内吞作用在易感性表型中被过度表达。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了韧性-易感性分化的新的分子机制。
